about_the_game:
Embark on a high-octane naval adventure with this Navy-themed pinball table, featuring intense sea battles, military strategy, and underwater missions!

🚢 Authentic Navy design – Navigate a table filled with battleships, aircraft carriers, and naval warfare elements.
⚓ Mission-driven gameplay – Complete tactical naval operations and objectives to unlock bonuses and high scores.
🌊 Multiple ramps and bumpers – Master the layout to maneuver around ships, water hazards, and obstacles.
💥 Bonus features – Unlock hidden areas and rewards through expert play.
🛠️ Ballistic Submarine Challenge – Take on the unique submarine challenge, navigating dangerous waters for bonus points.
🧩 Dynamic puzzles – Solve interactive table mechanics to earn extra points and unlock secrets.
🔧 Realistic pinball physics, including multi-ball action and naval mechanics.
🏆 Steam high score tracking – Compete for the top score and showcase your naval supremacy.
🎶 Naval-themed soundtrack, with sea shanties, ship sounds, and military voiceovers.
🎵 Music-controlled levels, where the action reacts to the intensity of the soundtrack.

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunge
